professionalSummary.text: Keeps the possession plan and the works schedule current with the contractor's progress.
professionalSummary.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Records possession briefings and site access permits under the programme's procedures.
experienceHighlights.witness: The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Prepares the weekly progress report for the infrastructure owner's representative.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

skills.text: Tracks equipment deliveries against the schedule, with possession decisions staying with the project manager, and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in maintaining possession plans, recording briefings, preparing reports, tracking deliveries, and writing hand-over notes. They do not establish the candidate's ability to manage multiple sites simultaneously or the exact nature of the project manager's involvement.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate's experience and work samples align with the role's requirements, but further verification is needed to confirm the exact nature of their responsibilities and the project manager's involvement.

evidence.text: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.
The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.
Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
